about: Routing prompts for the skill descriptions in skills/. A prompt is a message a person might send and the one skill that should load for it, or null for none. A prompt with a near field looks like that skill and belongs elsewhere. Tune prompts were written by the builder and are used to fix descriptions. Holdout prompts were written by a model that never saw a description, are scored once, and a second look at the same set is a tuned set. Run 100x eval triggers stage to get what a model answers from.

distractors.name: api-docs
distractors.description: Use when the user wants an API reference written or refreshed: OpenAPI specs, endpoint pages, request and response examples. Reads the routes and handlers and keeps the docs in step with them.

distractors.name: commit-helper
distractors.description: Use when the user wants a commit message or a pull request description written from a diff, or a large diff split into logical commits. Follows conventional commits.

distractors.name: data-viz
distractors.description: Use when the user wants a chart or plot from CSV or JSON data: bar, line, scatter, histogram. Picks the chart type, labels the axes and saves a PNG or SVG.

distractors.name: i18n
distractors.description: Use when the user wants user facing strings extracted into locale files, new languages added, or translations checked for missing keys and placeholders.

distractors.name: pdf-forms
distractors.description: Use when the user wants to fill in, read or extract data from PDF forms and tables, including scanned invoices and tax forms.

distractors.name: release-notes
distractors.description: Use when the user wants release notes or a changelog written from merged pull requests and commits, grouped by feature, fix and breaking change.

distractors.name: slide-deck
distractors.description: Use when the user wants a presentation made from an outline or notes: slide titles, bullet points, speaker notes and a consistent layout.

distractors.name: terraform-review
distractors.description: Use when the user wants a Terraform plan or module reviewed for risky changes: destroys, open security groups, missing tags, state drift.
